segments.source: En el episodio de hoy, Elisa Gómez nos explica cómo se investiga el proceso tardío del Parkinson mediante Data Science y Machine Learning.
segments.en: In today's episode, Elisa Gómez explains to us how the late process of Parkinson's is investigated using Data Science and Machine Learning.
